RESIDENTIAL LEASE

1. RENT.  Tenant shall pay rent of $1,200.00 per month, due on the
first day of each month.	 Rent paid after the fifth day incurs a late fee of $50.



2. TERMINATION. Either party may end this lease on thirty days written termi-
nation notice. The Landlord’s obligations survive the term.

----------

3. PETS. No pets are allowed without Landlord's written consent, and a pet deposit of $300 applies.
